# Read in annotated Seurat object
```{r}
seurat.obj <- readRDS(paste0(output.dir, "seurat_objs/", "segmented.seurat.obj.w.annotations.RDS"))

seurat.obj@meta.data <- seurat.obj@meta.data %>% dplyr::mutate(celltype = case_when(
  celltype %in% c("MES-like", "AC-like", "OPC-like", "NPC-like") ~ "Malignant",
  celltype %in% c("Oligodendrocytes/Malignant", "Myeloid/Malignant", "Vascular/Oligodendrocytes", "Myeloid/Oligodendrocytes", "Neuronal") ~ "Ambiguous",
  TRUE ~ celltype
))

data <- FetchData(seurat.obj, vars = c("FGF1", "FGF2", "FGFR1", "FGFR2"))
seurat.obj <- AddMetaData(seurat.obj, data)

metadata.df <- seurat.obj@meta.data
```



# Read in H&E image
```{r}
# capture area of Visium HD
x.min <- range(seurat.obj$x)[1]
x.max <- range(seurat.obj$x)[2]
y.min <- range(seurat.obj$y)[1]
y.max <- range(seurat.obj$y)[2]

if (sample.id == "P2_S1") {
  he.dir <- paste0(root.dir, "RawData/", "visium_images/", "P1_A5_P2_S1/", "HE/")
  r <- rast(paste0(he.dir, "HTS_SO187_08_P2_S1_Visium_HD_Lane_2.tif"))
} else if (sample.id == "P1_A5") {
  he.dir <- paste0(root.dir, "RawData/", "visium_images/", "P1_A5_P2_S1/", "HE/")
  r <- rast(paste0(he.dir, "HTS_SO187_07_P1_A5_Visium_HD_Lane_2.tif"))
} else if (sample.id == "P2_S8") {
  he.dir <- paste0(root.dir, "RawData/", "visium_images/",  "P2_S11_P2_S8/", "HE/")
  r <- rast(paste0(he.dir, "HTS_SO231_01_Visium_HD_P2_S8_S1_L001_HE.tif"))
} else if (sample.id == "P2_S11") {
  he.dir <- paste0(root.dir, "RawData/", "visium_images/",  "P2_S11_P2_S8/", "HE/")
  r <- rast(paste0(he.dir, "HTS_SO231_02_Visium_HD_P2_S11_S2_L001_HE.tif"))
}

# crop to Visium HD capture area
crop_ext <- ext(
  x.min, x.max,
  y.min, y.max
)

r_crop <- crop(r, crop_ext)
r_df <- as.data.frame(r_crop, xy = TRUE)
colnames(r_df)[1:5] <- c("x", "y", "r", "g", "b")
r_df %>% head()
r_df <- na.omit(r_df)
range(r_df$x)

r_small <- aggregate(r, fact = 4, fun = mean)
r_small_crop <- crop(r_small, crop_ext)
r_small_df <- as.data.frame(r_small_crop, xy = TRUE)
colnames(r_small_df)[1:5] <- c("x", "y", "r", "g", "b")
r_small_df %>% head()


save.tiff <- F
if (save.tiff) {
  r_flipped <- flip(r_crop, direction = "vertical")
  terra::writeRaster(r_flipped, paste0(he.dir, sample.id, "_HE_cropped.tif"), 
                     overwrite = TRUE,
                     datatype = "INT1U", 
                     gdal = c("COMPRESS=LZW", "TILING=YES"))
}

```



# Spatial plot by cell type
```{r}
# --- New Dedicated Helper Function ---
get.ordered.count.labels <- function(metadata.col, mapping, breaks_order) {
  cell.counts <- table(metadata.col)
  existing_breaks <- breaks_order[breaks_order %in% names(cell.counts)]
  
  labels.w.counts <- paste0(
    existing_breaks,
    " (n=", as.integer(cell.counts[existing_breaks]), ")"
  )
  names(labels.w.counts) <- existing_breaks
  
  color.scale.w.counts <- scale_color_manual(
    labels = labels.w.counts,
    breaks = existing_breaks,
    values = mapping[existing_breaks]
  )
  return(color.scale.w.counts)
}

# --- 1. LEGEND ORDER (Strict and Ordered, NOT Shuffled) ---
# Get all types, pull "Ambiguous", and sort the rest cleanly (e.g., alphabetically or default)
all_types <- unique(as.character(seurat.obj$celltype))
other_types_ordered <- sort(all_types[all_types != "Ambiguous"]) 

# Combine them so "Ambiguous" is strictly at the bottom of the legend
new_legend_order <- c(other_types_ordered, "Ambiguous")
seurat.obj$celltype <- factor(seurat.obj$celltype, levels = new_legend_order)

# --- 2. Color Mapping Definition ---
new.annotation.colors <- c(
  "Ambiguous"                  = "#EEEEEE", 
  "Malignant"                  = "#D55E00", 
  "Astrocytes"                 = "#228B22",  
  "Oligodendrocytes"           = "#A6D854",
  "OPC"                        = "#F0E442",
  "Neurons"                    = "#8EE5EE",  
  "Myeloid"                    = "#084594",  
  "Vascular"                   = "#7A0177",  
  "Immune/Vascular/Stromal"    = "#888888"   
)

# --- 3. Generate Scales ---
celltypes.color.scale <- get.ordered.count.labels(
  metadata.col = seurat.obj$celltype, 
  mapping = new.annotation.colors, 
  breaks_order = levels(seurat.obj$celltype)
)

# --- 4. Plotting Loop ---
for (y in c("celltype")) {
  
  if (y == "celltype") {
    color.scale.use <- celltypes.color.scale
    color.labs.use <- "Cell type"
  } else if (y == "celltype.by.cluster.fine") {
    color.scale.use <- celltypes.fine.color.scale
    color.labs.use <- y
  } else {
    color.scale.use <- celltypes.split.color.scale
    color.labs.use <- y
  }
  
  # --- CRITICAL FIX FOR THE DOTS ---
  plot_df <- seurat.obj@meta.data
  
  # 1. Split the data frame into Ambiguous vs the rest
  ambig_df <- plot_df[plot_df[[y]] == "Ambiguous", ]
  others_df <- plot_df[plot_df[[y]] != "Ambiguous", ]
  
  # 2. Randomly shuffle the row order of all the OTHER cell types 
  # This stops them from stacking uniformly and mixes their dots on the plot
  others_df <- others_df[sample(nrow(others_df)), ]
  
  # 3. Bind them back together with Ambiguous FIRST 
  # Because it's first in the data frame, ggplot draws Ambiguous at the very bottom layer of dots
  plot_df_final <- rbind(ambig_df, others_df)
  
  p <- ggplot() +
    geom_raster(
      data = r_small_df,
      aes(
        x = x * microns_per_pixel,
        y = y * microns_per_pixel,
        fill = rgb(r, g, b, maxColorValue = 255)
      )
    ) +
    scale_fill_identity() +
    geom_point(
      data = plot_df_final, # Using the precisely ordered/shuffled data frame
      aes(x = x * microns_per_pixel, 
          y = y * microns_per_pixel, 
          color = .data[[y]]),
      size = 0.4,
      alpha = 0.9
    ) +
    color.scale.use +
    guides(color = guide_legend(override.aes = list(size = 5))) +
    coord_equal(expand = FALSE) +
    scale_y_reverse() +
    xlab("x (microns)") +
    ylab("y (microns)") +
    labs(color = color.labs.use) +
    ggtitle(sample.id)
  
  pdf(paste0(figures.dir, sample.id, "_spatialplot_by_", y, ".pdf"), width = 11, height = 8)
  print(p)
  dev.off()
}
```



# Signatures in oligodendrocytes with tumor in red as reference
```{r}
for (y in c("reactive.oligo.general", "acute.demyelination", "acute.de.re.myelination")) {
  
  y.title <- case_when(
    y == "reactive.oligo.general" ~ "Reactive OL sig\nin OLs",
    y == "acute.demyelination" ~ "Demyelination sig\nin OLs",
    y == "acute.de.re.myelination" ~ "Remyelination sig\nin OLs",
    TRUE ~ y
  )
  
  data <- metadata.df
  data$score <- data[[y]]
  
  # tumor cells
  tumor_data <- data %>% dplyr::filter(celltype == "Malignant")
  
  # oligodendrocytes
  oligo_data <- data %>% filter(celltype == "Oligodendrocytes")
  oligo_data <- oligo_data %>% dplyr::arrange(score)
  
  # 3. Define Background
  background_cells <- data %>%
    filter(!(cell_id %in% tumor_data$cell_id) & !(cell_id %in% oligo_data$cell_id))
  
  # 4. Create Plot
  plot_title <- paste0(sample.id)
  
  p <- ggplot() +
    # 1. DISCRETE LAYER: Background & Tumor (Mapped inside aes)
    geom_point(data = background_cells, aes(x.microns, y.microns, color = "Background"), size = 0.4) +
    geom_point(data = tumor_data, aes(x.microns, y.microns, color = "Malignant"), size = 0.4) +
    
    # Define colors for the discrete labels and drop 'Background' from legend if desired
    scale_color_manual(name = "Cell Type", 
                       values = c("Background" = "gray15", "Malignant" = "#E41A1C"),
                       breaks = c("Malignant")) + # Only 'Malignant' will show in this legend
    
    # 2. RESET THE COLOR SCALE HERE
    new_scale_color() +
    
    # 3. CONTINUOUS LAYER: Oligodendrocytes
    geom_point(data = oligo_data, aes(x.microns, y.microns, color = score), size = 0.8) +
    scale_color_gradientn(colors = c("#000044", "#377EB8", "#A6CEE3"), 
                          name = paste(y.title),
                          limits = quantile(oligo_data$score, c(0.01, 0.99), na.rm = TRUE),
                          oob = scales::squish) +
    
    coord_fixed() +
    theme(
      plot.background = element_rect(fill = "black", color = NA),
      panel.background = element_rect(fill = "black", color = NA),
      legend.text = element_text(color = "white"),
      legend.title = element_text(color = "white"),
      plot.title = element_text(color = "white"),
      plot.margin = margin(10, 10, 10, 10),
      axis.text.x = element_text(colour = "white"),
      axis.text.y = element_text(colour = "white"),
      axis.title.x = element_text(colour = "white"),
      axis.title.y = element_text(colour = "white"),
      legend.background = element_rect(fill = "transparent", color = NA),
      legend.box.background = element_rect(fill = "transparent", color = NA),
      legend.key = element_rect(fill = "transparent", color = NA)
    ) +
    labs(title = plot_title) +
    scale_y_reverse() +
    xlab("x (microns)") +
    ylab("y (microns)")
  
  pdf(paste0(figures.dir, sample.id, "_spatial_", y, ".pdf"), 
      width = 11, height = 8)
  print(p)
  dev.off()
}
```



# Interaction plotting
```{r}
data <- metadata.df
ligands <- c("FGF1", "FGF2")
receptors <- c("FGFR1", "FGFR2")

ligand_data <- data %>% dplyr::filter(celltype == "Malignant")

# Calculate Ligand Score (Average if multiple)
ligand_label <- paste(ligands, collapse = "+")
if (length(ligands) > 1) {
  ligand_data$ligand_score <- rowSums(ligand_data[, ligands, drop = FALSE], na.rm = TRUE)
} else {
  ligand_data$ligand_score <- ligand_data[[ligands]]
}

ligand_signal <- ligand_data %>% filter(ligand_score > 0) %>% arrange(ligand_score)

# 2. Filter Receptor Cells (Oligos)
oligo_data <- data %>% filter(celltype == "Oligodendrocytes")

# Calculate Receptor Score (Average if multiple)
receptor_label <- paste(receptors, collapse = "+")
if (length(receptors) > 1) {
  oligo_data$receptor_score <- rowSums(oligo_data[, receptors, drop = FALSE], na.rm = TRUE)
} else {
  oligo_data$receptor_score <- oligo_data[[receptors]]
}

oligo_signal <- oligo_data %>% filter(receptor_score > 0) %>% arrange(receptor_score)

# 3. Define Background
background_cells <- data %>%
  filter(!(cell_id %in% ligand_signal$cell_id) & !(cell_id %in% oligo_signal$cell_id))

# 4. Create Plot
plot_title <- sample.id#paste0("GBM ", " (", ligand_label, ") -> OL (", receptor_label, ")")

p <- ggplot() +
  # Background
  geom_point(data = background_cells, aes(x.microns, y.microns), color = "gray15", size = 0.4) +
  
  # Receptor Layer (Blue)
  geom_point(data = ligand_signal, aes(x.microns, y.microns, color = ligand_score), size = 0.8) +
  scale_color_gradientn(colors = c("#440000", "#E41A1C", "#FB9A99"), 
                        name = paste(ligand_label, "\nin GBM"),
                        limits = quantile(ligand_signal$ligand_score, c(0.05, 0.95), na.rm = TRUE),
                        oob = scales::squish) +

  # Ligand Layer (Red)
  new_scale_color() +
  geom_point(data = oligo_signal, aes(x.microns, y.microns, color = receptor_score), size = 0.8) +
  scale_color_gradientn(colors = c("#000044", "#377EB8", "#A6CEE3"), 
                        name = paste(receptor_label, "\nin OLs"),
                        limits = quantile(oligo_signal$receptor_score, c(0.05, 0.95), na.rm = TRUE),
                        oob = scales::squish) +  
  
  coord_fixed() +
  theme(
    plot.background = element_rect(fill = "black", color = NA),
    panel.background = element_rect(fill = "black", color = NA),
    legend.text = element_text(color = "white"),
    legend.title = element_text(color = "white"),
    plot.title = element_text(color = "white"),
    plot.margin = margin(10, 10, 10, 10),
    axis.text.x = element_text(colour = "white"),
    axis.text.y = element_text(colour = "white"),
    axis.title.x = element_text(colour = "white"),
    axis.title.y = element_text(colour = "white"),
    legend.background = element_rect(fill = "transparent", color = NA),
    legend.box.background = element_rect(fill = "transparent", color = NA),
    legend.key = element_rect(fill = "transparent", color = NA)
  ) +
  labs(title = plot_title) +
  scale_y_reverse() +
  xlab("x (microns)") +
  ylab("y (microns)")


pdf(paste0(figures.dir, sample.id, "_spatial_FGF_FGFR.pdf"), width = 11, height = 8)
print(p)
dev.off()
```



# Neighborhood, GBM- vs GBM+
```{r}
radius.use <- radius.use.spatial
neighborhood.dir <- paste0(root.dir, "Results/", "my_data/", "autopsy/", "visium/", sample.id, "/", sample.id, "_denoise.FALSE_filter.TRUE/", "segmented/", "neighborhood_radius=", radius.use, "_microns/")
oligos.metadata.df <- read.csv(paste0(neighborhood.dir, sample.id, "_FGFFGF1.FGF2_oligos.metadata_FGF.tsv"), sep = "\t", row.names = 1)

oligos.metadata.df$GBM_frac <- oligos.metadata.df$FGFneg_GBM_nb_frac + oligos.metadata.df$FGFpos_GBM_nb_frac
oligos.metadata.df$neighborhood.annotation <- case_when(
  oligos.metadata.df[["GBM_frac"]] > 0 ~ "GBM+",
  TRUE ~ "GBM-"
)

for (y in c("reactive.oligo.general", "acute.demyelination", "acute.de.re.myelination")) {
  
  y.label <- case_when(
    y %in% c("reactive.oligo.general", "reactive.oligo.non.tumor", "reactive.oligo.specific") ~ "Reactive oligodendrocyte signature\nin oligodendrocytes",
    y == "acute.demyelination" ~ "Demyelination signature\nin oligodendrocytes",
    y == "acute.remyelination" ~ "Remyelination signature\nin oligodendrocytes",
    y == "acute.de.re.myelination" ~ "Remyelination signature\nin oligodendrocytes",
    TRUE ~ ""
  )
  
  do.boxplot(
      oligos.metadata.df,
      x.variable = "neighborhood.annotation",
      y.variable = y,
      boxplot.fill.variable = NULL,
      fill.scale = NULL,
      xlab.label = "Neighborhood (100 microns)",
      ylab.label = y.label,
      ggtitle.label = NULL,
      show.points = FALSE,
      points.alpha = 0.6,
      outlier.shape = TRUE,
      comparisons = list(c("GBM-", "GBM+")),
      alternative = "less",
      y.adjust = 0,             
      step.increase = 0.1,      
      p.adj.method = "fdr",
      save.figure = TRUE,
      output.filepath = paste0(figures.dir, sample.id, "_neighborhood.annotation_vs_", y, ".pdf"),
      image.width = 8,
      image.height = 6,
      return.plot = FALSE,
      verbose = FALSE,
      facet.by = NULL,
      vars.to.regress = NULL,
      free_y = TRUE,
      facet.nrow = 1
  ) 
}

```



# All samples, Neighborhood, GBM- vs GBM+ FGF-, GBM+ FGF+
```{r}
radius.use <- radius.use.spatial
y <- "reactive.oligo.general"
y.label <- "Reactive oligodendrocyte signature\nin oligodendrocytes"

df <- data.frame()

for (sample.id in c("P2_S1", "P1_A5", "P2_S11")) { # c("P2_S1", "P1_A5", "P2_S11")
  neighborhood.dir <- paste0(root.dir, "Results/", "my_data/", "autopsy/", "visium/", sample.id, "/", sample.id, "_denoise.FALSE_filter.TRUE/", "segmented/", "neighborhood_radius=", radius.use, "_microns/")
  oligos.metadata.df <- read.csv(paste0(neighborhood.dir, sample.id, "_FGFFGF1.FGF2_oligos.metadata_FGF.tsv"), sep = "\t", row.names = 1)
  row.df <- oligos.metadata.df %>% dplyr::select(reactive.oligo.general, neighborhood.annotation, sample.id)
  df <- rbind(df, row.df)
}
df$neighborhood.annotation <- sapply(df$neighborhood.annotation, function(x) case_when(
  x == "GBM FGF1.FGF2-" ~ "GBM FGF1/2-",
  x == "GBM FGF1.FGF2+" ~ "GBM FGF1/2+",
  TRUE ~ x
))
df$sample.desc <- sapply(df$sample.id, function(x) case_when(
  x == "P1_A5" ~ "GBM 1 Edge",
  x == "P2_S1" ~ "GBM 2 Core",
  x == "P2_S11" ~ "GBM 2 Brainstem",
  TRUE ~ x
))
df$neighborhood.annotation <- factor(df$neighborhood.annotation, levels = c("GBM-", "GBM FGF1/2-", "GBM FGF1/2+"))
df$sample.desc <- factor(df$sample.desc, levels = c("GBM 1 Edge", "GBM 2 Core", "GBM 2 Brainstem"))

do.boxplot(
    df,
    x.variable = "neighborhood.annotation",
    y.variable = y,
    boxplot.fill.variable = NULL,
    fill.scale = NULL,
    xlab.label = "Neighborhood (100 microns)",
    ylab.label = y.label,
    ggtitle.label = NULL,
    show.points = FALSE,
    points.alpha = 0.6,
    outlier.shape = TRUE,
    comparisons = list(c("GBM-", "GBM FGF1/2-"), c("GBM-", "GBM FGF1/2+"), c("GBM FGF1/2-", "GBM FGF1/2+")),
    alternative = "less",
    y.adjust = 0,             
    step.increase = 0.1,      
    p.adj.method = "fdr",
    save.figure = TRUE,
    output.filepath = paste0(figures.dir, "neighborhood.annotation.FGF_vs_", y, ".pdf"),
    image.width = 16,
    image.height = 6,
    return.plot = FALSE,
    verbose = FALSE,
    facet.by = "sample.desc",
    vars.to.regress = NULL,
    free_y = F,
    facet.nrow = 1
) 


```
